stem_block:
NUDGES IN PUBLIC POLICY, AND HOW THEY ARE TESTED

Households behind with a bill were sent a letter saying that most of their neighbours had already paid, and payment rates went up. How far up is disputed: the figure the papers carried came from one pilot in a single town, while the larger trials put the rise at about (37) ........ percentage points. Repeating an intervention across many sites usually leaves an effect only around (38) ........ per cent of the size first published, partly because striking results are easier to publish than dull ones, and some effects fade once the novelty has gone. There is also the question of who chooses the default, since that person has interests of their own; what separates help from obstruction is whether the arrangement advances the (39) ........ of the individual concerned. Method matters as well: allocating real customers at random is what shows that the wording caused the difference, and (40) ........ the prediction openly in advance keeps the analysis from being reworked later.

items.prompt: the larger trials put the rise at about (37) ........ percentage points
items.evidence: Across the larger trials the effect settles at about five percentage points
items.explanation: The fifteen-point rise reported in the papers comes from a pilot in a single town; in the larger trials the effect stays around five points.

items.prompt: Repeating an intervention across many sites usually leaves an effect only around (38) ........ per cent of the size first published
items.evidence: the average effect is often around forty per cent of what the original study reported
items.explanation: When the same intervention is repeated across many sites, the average effect comes out at about forty per cent of what the original study reported.

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: 3/3 kor turda bilindi: yineleme yazininin bilinen 'etki yariya iner' bulgusu bosluga tek dogal aday birakiyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 2: senaryodaki deger yerinde degistirildi (half -> forty per cent) ve bosluk sayisal hale getirildi ('(38) per cent'). Kuyruk sozcukler ('per cent of the size first published') tek basina bir deger onermiyor. Turn_index ve answer_point_id degismedi.

items.prompt: what separates help from obstruction is whether the arrangement advances the (39) ........ of the individual concerned
items.evidence: the usual one is whether the person's own goals are being served
items.explanation: The usual question asked to distinguish helping from obstructing is whether the person's own goals are being served.

items.prompt: (40) ........ the prediction openly in advance keeps the analysis from being reworked later
items.evidence: registering your prediction publicly before you collect the data is what stops the analysis being adjusted afterwards
items.explanation: The second safeguard in the method section: registering the prediction openly before the data is collected stops the analysis from being altered afterwards.
